sentences.en: I was immersed in the happy atmosphere of the occasion.
sentences.zh: 我沉浸在那个场合欢乐的氛围中。

sentences.en: It's OK to leave the baby to cry on occasion.
sentences.zh: 偶尔把宝宝哭着留下也是可以的。

sentences.en: You should change your job if the occasion arises.
sentences.zh: 如果有机会的话你应该换份工作。

senses.zh: (发生特殊事件)的时刻;机会,理由;需要
